mapper.select: SELECT id FROM knowledge_spaces WHERE kind = 'platform' OR (kind = 'organization' AND organization_id = #{organizationId}) ORDER BY kind, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_documents (id, space_id, title, filename, mime, status, source_key, created_by, error_message) VALUES (#{id}, #{spaceId}, #{title}, #{filename}, #{mime}, #{status}, #{sourceKey}, #{createdBy}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::int FROM knowledge_documents WHERE space_id = #{spaceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_documents SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, published_at = CASE WHEN #{published} THEN now() ELSE published_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_jobs (id, document_id, kind, status, error_message) VALUES (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_jobs SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
